notes.title: Keep calm and let us fix it
notes.content:
We have a small list with the hot fixes for our players:

Resolved the problem with the safe box puzzle.
Changed the collision on the table in the train station.
The door lock issue was fixed. What Is Hacked May Never Hack.
Fixed load level trigger in the town.
Reduced delay in dialogs.
Fixed the hidden police officer.
